page.overview:
Who is Nisain a'Cowel?

Nisain a'Cowel is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is gangly with a strong chin, dark reddish hair and startlingly blue eyes. She has a lilting voice. , Nisain a'Cowel|Nisain}}.

Nisain is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Caren Endelle and Bennae Nalsad, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She has the Talent of reading weaves made of saidar; among the six rebel sisters sent to Shadar Logoth, she was the best.
